title: Executive Employment Agreement (Chief Financial Officer) - Veltrane Cardiac Systems, Inc.
fictional_notice: All parties and facts are invented.

defects.title: Twelve-month post-employment noncompete
defects.why: Section 9.2 bars the executive from working for any competing business in the United States for twelve months after termination. A noncompete in an employment contract is void however narrowly tailored, and it is unlawful to include one.
quotes: For a period of twelve (12) months after the Termination Date, Executive shall not, anywhere in the United States, be employed by, provide services to, or serve as an officer, director or consultant of any Competing Business in a finance, strategy or executive capacity.

defects.title: Invention assignment reaches own-time, unrelated inventions and gives no notice
defects.why: Section 8.2 assigns every invention made during the Term whether or not on working hours, with Company resources or related to the Company's business, and the agreement gives no written notice of the statutory exclusion. The assignment cannot reach inventions developed entirely on the employee's own time without employer resources that are unrelated to the employer's business.
quotes: at any time during the Term, whether or not during working hours, whether or not with the use of the Company's equipment, facilities or information, and whether or not related to the Company's business

defects.title: Waiver of reimbursement for phone, internet and home office costs
defects.why: Schedule 1, paragraph 4 makes the executive bear phone, internet and home office costs used for Company work and waive reimbursement. The employer must reimburse necessary business expenses and a waiver of that right is void.
quotes: Executive shall bear, without reimbursement from the Company, the cost of Executive's mobile phone service, home internet service and home office equipment and supplies used in performing services for the Company, and Executive waives any claim to be reimbursed for those costs.

defects.title: Final wages paid on next regular payroll date
defects.why: Section 6.1 pays final salary and other wages on the next regular payroll date after termination. Earned wages are due immediately on discharge and within 72 hours on resignation without notice.
quotes: The Company shall pay the Base Salary and other wages included in the Accrued Obligations on the Company's next regularly scheduled payroll date following the Termination Date

defects.title: Accrued vacation forfeited on termination for Cause
defects.why: Section 4.2 forfeits accrued, unused vacation when the Company terminates for Cause. An employment contract may not provide for forfeiture of vested vacation on termination; it must be paid as wages at the final rate.
quotes: If the Company terminates Executive's employment for Cause, all accrued and unused vacation shall be forfeited as of the Termination Date and no payment shall be made for it.

defects.title: Repayment of a paid annual bonus on resignation
defects.why: Section 3.6 requires the executive to repay the full amount of an earned and paid Annual Bonus if the executive resigns within twelve months after payment, and allows set-off. An employer may not collect back wages already paid.
quotes: If Executive resigns for any reason within twelve (12) months after the date on which an Annual Bonus is paid, Executive shall repay to the Company, within thirty (30) days after the Termination Date, the full gross amount of that Annual Bonus

defects.title: Ban on disclosing own compensation to other employees
defects.why: Schedule 1, paragraph 5 forbids the executive from disclosing salary, bonus or equity amounts to other employees. An employer may not require an employee to refrain from disclosing the amount of the employee's wages.
quotes: Executive shall not disclose the amount of Executive's Base Salary, Annual Bonus or equity awards to any other employee of the Company

defects.title: Earned salary and bonus conditioned on signing a release
defects.why: Section 6.5 conditions payment of earned, unpaid Base Salary and earned Annual Bonus (clauses (i) and (ii) of the Accrued Obligations) on the executive signing a general release. An employer may not require a release of a claim for wages due unless those wages have been paid.
quotes: including the Accrued Obligations described in clauses (i) and (ii) of Section 1.1(a), is conditioned on Executive signing the Release and the Release becoming effective and irrevocable within sixty (60) days after the Termination Date
